purpose: Official-source posture for the Composition trust surface: measurement context, strength/recovery/adherence interpretation, device-estimate caveats, privacy, and non-appearance copy.

sources.title: CDC: About Body Mass Index (BMI)
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.product_use: BMI and related body measures are treated as partial screening context, not direct composition truth or identity judgment.

sources.title: CDC: Adding Physical Activity as an Adult
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.product_use: The screen connects interpretation to strength work, recovery, and consistent activity instead of appearance pressure.

sources.title: FDA 510(k): Transtek Body Fat Analyzer K130311
sources.product_use: BIA-style device outputs are handled as estimates for generally healthy adults and not as diagnostic coaching commands.

sources.title: NCBI Bookshelf: Factors That Influence Body Weight
sources.publisher: National Library of Medicine / National Academies Press
sources.product_use: Interpretation must account for personal, training, diet, sleep, physiology, and environmental context before suggesting changes.

sources.title: TransformFitAI Composition Trust Protocol
sources.product_use: Every composition-facing surface must say signals are imperfect, stay private by default, avoid appearance-pressure copy, and connect trends to strength, recovery, adherence, and scoped nutrition.

safety_rules: Frame measurements as signals, not verdicts.
Do not diagnose, prescribe, or rank appearance.
Require strength, recovery, adherence, and nutrition context before changing a plan.
Keep composition surfaces private by default unless a future explicit opt-in share flow exists.
Block appearance-pressure and shame-framed terms from app copy.
